key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main window in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main window in pixels.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window is maximized.

key.name: language
key.description: Selected UI language. "auto" follows the system locale; any other value forces that language at startup by setting LANGUAGE.

key.name: number-format
key.description: Decimal separator, thousands separator, and clipboard handling for display, copy, and paste. "auto" follows the system locale and parses pasted values tolerantly; "os" follows the system locale strictly; "us" is 1,234.56; "fr" is 1 234,56; "eu" is 1.234,56.
